dimensions.note: Both credential arguments are sensitive; README uses vault references and least-privilege guidance.
The three public methods emit no entry or completion logs.
verifyReadAccess and listObjects propagate raw SDK failures, unlike downloadObject's sanitized operation errors.
Tests cover prefix/range bounds, malformed metadata, cleanup, size races, stream mismatch, sanitization, and persistence.
Operations are read-only; download uses a persisted pending recovery marker and stable output names.
AWS SDK commands, response validation, one-page bounded listing, and byte/range limits are explicit.
Clients and verification readers are cleaned up on success and failure paths.
README and fixtures use example endpoints and placeholder credentials.
Global, method, resource, and metadata schemas are strict.
Every resource and file declares explicit lifetime and GC retention.
Purposefully read-only object access; no cloud resource lifecycle is managed.
Each spec uses a distinct stable instance name; pending and complete metadata intentionally share identity.
Initial standalone publication; no prior published version exists.
